title: 第 3 课 · 点亮 LED：限流电阻与极性
summary: LED 有正负极，还必须串一个电阻。电阻值怎么算？
concepts: forward voltage Vf 正向压降
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **LED 发光二极管**（左侧会自动打开）：两只脚、PN 结、I–V 曲线。
**这一课学什么**：LED 的极性、正向压降，以及怎样算限流电阻。
**1. LED 有方向（polarity）**
| 脚 | 名字 | 接到 |
| 长脚 | 正极 anode | 朝 + 那一侧（经过电阻到 +5V） |
| 短脚 | 负极 cathode | 朝 GND 那一侧 |
电流只能从 anode 流向 cathode，插反了不会亮。本课 5 V 电路里插反一般不会坏：常见 LED 能承受的反向电压（规格书里的 VR）约 5 V，电源更高时插反就可能损坏。
**2. LED 两端的电压几乎固定：正向压降 Vf**
| 颜色 | Vf（约） |
电源多出来的电压必须由别的元件“吃掉”，否则电流会非常大、LED 会烧掉。
**3. 限流电阻（current-limiting resistor）**
电阻和 LED 串联，电流相同；电阻两端的电压 = 电源电压 − Vf，所以
- **R = (V电源 − Vf) / I**
- 例：5 V 电源、绿色 LED（Vf ≈ 2.1 V）、想要约 20 mA：R = (5 − 2.1) / 0.02 ≈ 145 Ω，选最接近的常用值 **150 Ω**。
- 一般 LED 电流 5–20 mA 就够亮，不要超过 25 mA。
**4. 粗算 19 mA，实际 18 mA**
- 更准：Vf 会随电流略升，可以把 LED 想成“Vf + 约 12 Ω 的小电阻”（本模拟器就这样算）：I = (5 − 2.1) / (150 + 12) ≈ 18 mA。
- 挑电阻用粗算就够了，差 1–2 mA 没关系。
**5. 顺序无所谓**
电阻放在 LED 前面还是后面都可以：串联电路里电流处处相等。
**6. 本课电路**
5 V 面包板电源模块 → 150 Ω → 绿色 LED → GND。tests 检查 LED 亮，并测电阻两端电压（约 18 mA × 150 Ω ≈ 2.7 V）。

en.title: Lesson 3 · Light an LED: current-limiting resistor and polarity
en.summary: An LED has a positive and a negative side, and it always needs a resistor in series. How do you work out the resistor value?
description: Look at the **LED** teardown first (it opens on the left): legs, die, PN junction, I–V curve.
**What you learn**: LED polarity, the forward voltage, and how to work out the current-limiting resistor.
**1. An LED has a direction (polarity)**
| Lead | Name | Goes to |
| long lead | anode | the + side (through the resistor to +5V) |
| short lead | cathode | the GND side |

Current only flows from anode to cathode; plugged in backwards it stays dark. In this lesson's 5 V circuit a reversed LED usually survives: a typical LED withstands about 5 V in reverse (VR in the datasheet); with a higher supply a reversed LED can be damaged.
**2. The voltage across an LED is almost fixed: the forward voltage Vf**
| Colour | Vf (about) |
| red | 1.8 V |
| yellow | 2.0 V |
| green | 2.1 V |
| blue / white | 3.0 V |
Some other part has to take up the rest of the supply voltage; otherwise the current gets huge and the LED burns out.
**3. The current-limiting resistor**
Resistor and LED are in series, so they carry the same current; the resistor gets supply voltage − Vf, so
- **R = (V_supply − Vf) / I**
- Example: 5 V supply, green LED (Vf ≈ 2.1 V), about 20 mA wanted: R = (5 − 2.1) / 0.02 ≈ 145 Ω; take the nearest standard value, **150 Ω**.
- 5–20 mA is bright enough for an ordinary LED; stay below 25 mA.
**4. Roughly 19 mA, really 18 mA**
- Closer: Vf rises a little with current; think of the LED as "Vf plus a small resistance of about 12 Ω" (that is how this simulator models it): I = (5 − 2.1) / (150 + 12) ≈ 18 mA.
- For choosing a resistor the rough estimate is enough; 1–2 mA either way doesn't matter.
**5. Order doesn't matter**
The resistor can go before or after the LED: in a series circuit the current is the same everywhere.
**6. This lesson's circuit**
5 V breadboard power module → 150 Ω → green LED → GND. The tests check that the LED is on and measure the resistor's voltage (about 18 mA × 150 Ω ≈ 2.7 V).
steps: Plug the breadboard power module into column 1 (set to 5V). It plugs into tp1 / tn1 / bp1 / bn1 at the same time, so both the top and bottom pairs of rails are powered.
Red jumper tp4 → a4, bringing +5V to column 4.
Put the 150Ω resistor between b4 and b8 (a resistor has no polarity, either lead is fine).
Green LED: long lead (anode, positive) in c8, connected to the resistor; short lead (cathode, negative) in c11. The long lead must face the + side!

Blue jumper a11 → tn11: the LED's cathode goes back to GND. Do the math: the actual current is about 18mA (the quick estimate gives 19mA; the description explains why). Select the LED to see the measured current under "Properties" on the right.
hints: LED not lighting? First check whether it is in backwards: long lead toward the resistor / + side, short lead to GND.
R = (V − Vf) / I. A green LED's Vf is about 2.1V.
tests: LED on, about 2.7V across the resistor

steps.text: 把面包板电源模块插在第 1 列（设为 5V）。它会同时插进 tp1 / tn1 / bp1 / bn1：上下两组电源轨都有电了。
红色跳线 tp4 → a4，把 +5V 引到第 4 列。
150Ω 电阻插在 b4 和 b8 之间（电阻没有正负，哪只脚都行）。
绿色 LED：长脚（anode，正极）插 c8，接电阻；短脚（cathode，负极）插 c11。长脚要朝向 + 那一侧！
蓝色跳线 a11 → tn11，LED 负极回到 GND。算一算：实际电流约 18mA（粗算 19mA，原因见说明）。选中 LED，在右侧“属性”里能看到实测电流。

hints: LED 不亮？先看是不是插反了：长脚接电阻 / + 那侧，短脚接 GND。
R = (V − Vf) / I。绿色 LED 的 Vf 约 2.1V。
